The Lenovo Global Future Leaders Program is a highly selective program designed to develop Lenovo's next generation of business and technology leaders. Created for exceptional graduates, the program provides accelerated development opportunities for individuals ready to grow their careers and make an impact at one of the world's leading technology companies.

As a Global Future Leader, you'll gain hands-on experience through challenging assignments and rotational opportunities across Lenovo. You'll collaborate with teams and leaders around the world, building a broad understanding of our organization while developing the skills needed to create meaningful impact. During your first three years, you'll participate in cross-functional experiences, strategic projects, leadership development, and mentorship opportunities designed to accelerate your growth. From day one, you'll take on meaningful work, gain exposure to senior leaders, and help drive innovative solutions that deliver smarter technology for all. We're looking for ambitious problem-solvers, innovative thinkers, and future leaders who are energized by technology, embrace new challenges, and are eager to make an impact.

What You Can Expect as a GFL

• Cross-functional rotational experiences across Lenovo's business, providing broad exposure and diverse career experiences

• Meaningful business impact from day one through strategic projects and real-world challenges

• Exposure to senior leaders along with structured leadership development and mentorship

• Collaboration with global teams and stakeholders across one of the world's leading technology companies

• Accelerated career growth through innovation, continuous learning, and opportunities to influence the future of smarter technology for all

In This Global Future Leader Role, you will act as an AI Solution Architect

Role Overview

Lenovo is seeking a motivated early-career professional to join our AI Library team as an AI Solution Architect. This role is ideal for a recent or upcoming graduate who is passionate about Artificial Intelligence, technical solution design, and using technology to solve real-world customer challenges.

As an AI Solution Architect, you will help translate business needs and customer requirements into scalable, reliable, and repeatable AI solutions built on Lenovo’s AI Library. Working alongside senior solution architects, engineers, business analysts, sales teams, and partners, you will gain hands-on experience across the full AI solution lifecycle—from discovery and design to validation, readiness, and customer deployment. This role offers a unique opportunity to grow as a technical architect while helping shape Lenovo’s growing AI solution portfolio.

What You’ll Do

• Assist in designing end-to-end AI solutions that leverage Lenovo infrastructure, platforms, and services.

• Help create reference architectures, solution blueprints, and patterns for common AI use cases.

• Support senior architects in defining components, data flows, integration points, and security considerations.

• Align technical designs with customer requirements, performance needs, and Lenovo standards.

AI Library Solution Development & Readiness

• Contribute to the development and refinement of AI Library offerings to ensure they are modular, reusable, and scalable.

• Assist in evaluating partner AI solutions for inclusion in the AI Library from an architectural perspective.

• Help translate innovative AI concepts into standardized solution packages that can be delivered globally.

• Support creation of implementation guides, deployment runbooks, and technical documentation.

Technical Validation & Delivery Support

• Participate in proof-of-concept (PoC) activities and solution validation with engineering teams.

• Assist in testing, performance tuning, and optimization of AI solution components.

• Support readiness activities to ensure solutions can be deployed consistently by delivery and services teams.

Pre-Sales & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work with sales and senior architects to understand customer challenges and map them to AI solutions.

• Help prepare technical presentations, architecture diagrams, and solution overviews for internal and external stakeholders.

• Gather feedback from customers, field teams, and partners to inform improvements to AI Library offerings.

What You’ll Learn

•
How enterprise AI solutions are designed, validated, and brought into production at scale.

•
The interactions between AI models, data pipelines, infrastructure, platforms, and security in real-world architectures.

•
Best practices for building reusable reference architectures and repeatable AI solution patterns.

•
How solution architects work with sales, product, marketing, and services to drive customer adoption.

•
Practical approaches to translating business requirements into technical designs and trade-offs.

•
Customer-facing and executive communication skills from a solution architecture perspective.

Job Requirements

• Recent or upcoming Bachelor’s graduate; Master’s degree preferred in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical fields.

• Passion for AI, emerging technologies, and applying solution architecture to real-world business challenges.

Our mission is to transform breakthrough innovations into scalable businesses, powering Lenovo’s most advanced products and shaping the future of AI, edge computing, intelligent devices, and enterprise solutions.

About the Role

This is a hands-on technical role within the AI Solution Delivery organization of Lenovo CTO Org’s Tech Incubation team, reporting to the Director, AI Solution Delivery.

You will be responsible for deploying and operationalizing AI-powered solutions in real customer environments. Working closely with Product Management, Solution Architects, R&D teams, and customers, you will bridge the gap between prototype and production by implementing, integrating, tuning, and validating solutions on-site.

Success in this role requires a combination of software engineering, applied AI, systems integration, and customer-facing problem-solving. You must be comfortable working directly with customers, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and adapting solutions to real-world operating conditions.

This role requires extensive travel and extended customer-site engagements, which may reach 70–80% depending on project needs and incubation phase.

Key Responsibilities:

AI Solution Deployment & Integration

• Deploy AI-powered solutions in customer environments, including edge computing platforms, software applications, sensors, and supporting infrastructure.

• Integrate solutions with customer IT and operational systems, APIs, databases, and enterprise platforms.

• Develop and maintain integration code, automation scripts, and deployment tooling using Python and related technologies.

• Assess customer environments and ensure deployment readiness, connectivity, and system compatibility.

Applied AI & Solution Optimization

• Configure, tune, validate, and troubleshoot Computer Vision and AI models in production environments.

• Analyze field performance, identify root causes of accuracy issues, and optimize solution performance for real-world operating conditions.

• Collect and analyze deployment data to support continuous improvement and model refinement.

• Partner with R&D teams to communicate field findings and accelerate product maturity.

Customer Delivery & Technical Leadership

• Serve as the primary technical lead for customer deployment activities, driving implementation execution and coordinating with architects, product managers, R&D teams, and customer stakeholders.

• Lead complex technical issue resolution and coordinate cross-functional engineering teams when escalations are required.

• Conduct customer acceptance testing and validate deployment success criteria.

• Train customer teams on solution operation, best practices, and troubleshooting procedures.

• Field Documentation & Knowledge Management

• Create and maintain installation guides, deployment documentation, configuration records, and troubleshooting playbooks.

• Document lessons learned and best practices to improve future deployments and accelerate solution scalability.

Feedback Loop & Product Hardening

• Serve as the critical feedback channel to the core R&D team. Translate on-site deployment issues, hardware limitations, integration challenges, and algorithmic edge cases into structured, actionable engineering insights.

• Capture and distill delivery experience into optimization recommendations for both software and hardware components, relaying timely feedback to Solution Architects and the R&D team.

• Compliance, Data Privacy & IP Protection

• Adhere to customer safety, security, privacy, and compliance requirements during all deployment activities.

• Protect customer data and Lenovo intellectual property in accordance with company policies, contractual obligations, and applicable regulations.

What We Look For

• Hands-on problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of software, AI, systems integration, and customer deployment.

• Strong customer orientation and ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where solutions are evolving rapidly.

• Highly self-directed with strong ownership and accountability.

• Passion for transforming innovative technologies into real-world customer success.

Lenovo is seeking an experienced Senior Technical Product Manager to shape the roadmap and drive delivery for our enterprise Hybrid Cloud Platform.

In this role, you will define the core capabilities that connect on-premises data centers with public clouds, giving enterprise customers a unified, reliable environment to run and manage their applications. You will focus on what to build and why—defining platform features across compute, storage, networking, and access control that make it easy for engineering teams and enterprise users to deploy workloads wherever they make the most sense.

You will treat both internal offering teams and external enterprise clients as your platform customers. Your mission is to listen to their needs, translate their technical challenges into clear product requirements, and partner with engineering squads who bring the technical architecture to life.

Key Responsibilities

1. Hybrid Cloud Strategy & Core Capabilities

• Define the product vision, roadmap, and release milestones for our hybrid cloud platform across private infrastructure and major public cloud providers.

• Specify core platform features across compute, storage, networking, and user authentication so teams can deploy and run applications seamlessly.

• Lead 0-to-1 MVP scoping for new platform releases, balancing customer-requested features against realistic delivery timelines.

2. Workload Management & Scaling

• Define requirements for workload placement, allowing customers to easily balance applications between their private environments and public cloud capacity.

• Ensure the platform provides reliable multi-tenant isolation, security policies, and health monitoring so customers trust it for production workloads.

• Run regular discovery sessions with platform users (both internal teams and external customers) to understand integration friction and day-to-day pain points.

• Specify self-service platform tools, clear APIs, and developer documentation that make onboarding smooth and self-guided.

• Author clear Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) and user stories that outline business value and acceptance criteria for engineering teams.

4. Cloud Economics & Usage Tracking

• Define capabilities that give customers visibility into their resource usage and spending across hybrid environments.

• Specify quota controls, budget alerts, and reporting dashboards so organizations can monitor their cloud investments with confidence.

5. AI & Modern Workload Readiness

• Ensure the platform is ready to support modern workloads, including allocating GPU resources and supporting modern AI tools and data services as customer demand grows.

• Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

• Demonstrated Cloud Offering Ownership: Prior hands-on experience operating as a Product Manager for a commercial or enterprise cloud offering/product (public, private, or hybrid cloud environments).

• Cloud & Infrastructure Fundamentals: Solid understanding of core cloud infrastructure components (compute, storage, and networking) and how private enterprise environments connect with public cloud platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP).

• Core Inbound PM Craft: Demonstrated experience gathering customer requirements, writing detailed PRDs, defining API interfaces, and prioritizing roadmaps using structured decision-making frameworks.

• Customer Empathy & Discovery: Strong background in customer discovery—uncovering underlying user needs and translating them into practical software capabilities.

• Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to bridge business goals with technical conversations and guide engineering squads toward shared outcomes.

Role Summary

This individual designs and validates cost-effective AI solutions that meet client and business requirements, translating complex needs into implementable architectures. Works primarily with development and delivery teams to ensure the design is built and delivered successfully, and supports the sales and offering teams as a technical advisor rather than a commercial owner. Hands-on work is situational — the ability to produce FDE-style mock-ups and prototypes is highly desired. This role is a blend of a technical background and a sales/business background to help deliver AI solutions to clients. This is not a purely AI focused role although that experience is needed.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design and Delivery

• Design end-to-end AI solution architectures — data pipelines, model serving, integration, and security controls — against functional and non-functional requirements.

• Define deployment strategy and the path from pilot to production; embed responsible-AI, privacy, and regulatory requirements in the design.

• Work day-to-day with the development team through build — design reviews, backlog shaping, and unblocking technical decisions.

Hands-On Technical Work

• Build FDE-style mock-ups, prototypes, and thin vertical slices to de-risk a design or make a concept tangible for the client.

• Prove out integration patterns, model behavior, and performance assumptions in code before the team commits to them.

• Contribute to the codebase where the situation calls for it — spikes, reference implementations, accelerators — without becoming a permanent delivery resource.

Go-to-Market Support (Sales and Offering Teams)

• Provide and review technical content for RFP/RFI responses, proposals, and SOWs; support pricing with defensible effort and run-cost inputs.

• Convert repeatable client patterns into productized offerings, accelerators, and reference architectures.

Technical Skills

• Languages & frameworks: Python (primary), SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript; FastAPI, LangChain or LlamaIndex, one agent framework.

• AI/ML: LLM prompting and evaluation, RAG, embeddings and vector stores, fine-tuning, guardrails, inference cost and latency optimization.

• Cloud & platforms: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud AI/ML stack; containers (Docker, Kubernetes), IaC (Terraform), CI/CD.

• Data: Data modeling, pipelines and ETL/ELT, streaming and batch patterns, lakehouse and warehouse platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent).

• Enterprise integration: REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven and messaging patterns, SSO and identity, integration with ERP, CRM, and ITSM platforms.

• Architecture & security: Reference and solution architecture documentation, non-functional design (scalability, availability, observability), data privacy and responsible-AI controls.

Required Qualifications:

Preferred Qualifications:

• Command of modern AI patterns: RAG, agentic workflows, fine-tuning, evaluation, and guardrails.
